title: 140 GHz single-bounce specular reflection applicability contract
recommendation: A single reflected-path diagnostic is defensible only with explicitly supplied facade/material geometry.

source_audit.role: complex TE/TM interface and finite-slab field coefficients
source_audit.assumptions: planar interface/slab, homogeneous isotropic media, plane-wave incidence; free-space spreading is not included
source_audit.output_semantics: field reflection/transmission coefficients plus power fractions after impedance/flux handling
source_audit.limitation: does not supply a finite urban-facade geometry, roughness BRDF, or antenna pattern

source_audit.role: urban site-data and statistical/multipath applicability boundary
source_audit.assumptions: scenario/morphology/statistical model-specific; current Table 4 rows are not an arbitrary deterministic facade GO solver
source_audit.output_semantics: median/basic transmission loss and multipath/polarization reference context
source_audit.limitation: does not justify adding one deterministic reflected path to a P.1411 median

source_audit.assumptions: far enough from source/aperture for spherical-wave 1/r behavior; point-to-point distance d
source_audit.output_semantics: field amplitude proportional to 1/d and power loss 20 log10(4πd/λ)
source_audit.limitation: not an urban obstruction, reflection coefficient, or finite-facade model

source_audit.role: official deterministic urban reflection/scatter geometry analogue
source_audit.assumptions: single-bounce reflection option, accurate building/terrain database, plane-wave incidence; finite diffuse facet has separate area/spreading terms
source_audit.output_semantics: perfect-mirror image-path power for an ideal reflector and separate scalar diffuse-scatter approximation
source_audit.limitation: not a 140 GHz calibrated facade model; diffuse formulation omits phase/polarization

source_audit.assumptions: RMS surface height within the first Fresnel zone and grazing/incidence angle are known
source_audit.output_semantics: dimensionless roughness parameter and coherent-specular reduction context
source_audit.limitation: does not provide Ankara facade roughness evidence

source_audit.source: Xing, Kanhere, Ju, Rappaport, Indoor Wireless Channel Properties at Millimeter Wave and Sub-Terahertz Frequencies
source_audit.role: peer-reviewed/archival 140 GHz reflection and scattering evidence
source_audit.assumptions: indoor measured materials and geometries, not Ankara exterior facades
source_audit.limitation: transferability requires a measurement campaign; it is not a universal facade coefficient

source_audit.assumptions: planar interface; nonideal media require a more complete image/boundary treatment
source_audit.output_semantics: image geometry, not a complete finite-facade received-power model
source_audit.limitation: not a substitute for the RF material and finite-aperture contract

geometry_contract.coordinates: local ENU metres; plane n·(x-p0)=0 with unit normal n
gates: both endpoints on declared exterior side
geometry_contract.invariant: d1 = |Tx-S|, d2 = |S-Rx|, L=d1+d2=|Tx_image-Rx| and incidence angle equals reflection angle

spreading_contract.field: E_ref = E0 * Gt(direction) * Gr(direction) * Gamma * exp(-j k L) / L
spreading_contract.power_reference: Pr_ref_dBm = Pt_dBm + Gt_dBi + Gr_dBi - FSPL(L) + 10 log10(|Gamma|^2) + declared non-geometric terms

candidate_a.decision: rejected for an ideal infinite/large planar specular mirror with dimensionless Gamma
candidate_a.reason: double free-space constants and yields a 1/(d1*d2)^2 power dependence without a finite-area/RCS normalization

candidate_d.expression: finite-facet physical-optics/diffuse-scatter area or RCS formulation
candidate_d.reason: requires finite reflector dimensions, aperture/area, roughness/statistics and a sourced physical-optics or BRDF model

coefficient_contract.interface_mode: use front-interface complex r_TE or r_TM when the facade is treated as semi-infinite/opaque or rear-interface coherence is unavailable
coefficient_contract.slab_mode: use P.2040 total R_TE/R_TM only when thickness, rear medium, layers, phase/coherence, angle and polarization are explicitly known
coefficient_contract.unknown_policy: interface_only or slab_coherence_unknown; never silently multiply an interface coefficient and a separate reflection loss
coefficient_contract.direct_plus_reflected: complex fields must be summed if a future multipath model is explicitly authorized; powers must not be added as though coherent

applicability_gates.required: surveyed or explicitly declared planar facade surface; footprint edge alone is insufficient
outward normal established from ring winding plus interior/exterior validation
specular point lies on the selected finite edge; infinite-plane solution is not enough
trusted or user-declared facade bottom/top; fallback 9 m is not evidence
explicit P.2040 row or characterized electrical properties; explicit thickness for slab mode
RMS height in relevant Fresnel zone and, where diffuse separation matters, correlation/texture evidence
Tx→S and S→Rx obstruction checks with reflecting endpoint exemption only
terrain layer or explicit flat-ground-relative-datum declaration
Tx departure and Rx arrival azimuth/elevation and an applicable directional pattern/aperture contract
explicit TE/TM or vector polarization decomposition from the actual incidence plane
physical aperture and range support for antenna and surface GO assumptions

composition_boundaries.p1411: deterministic single-bounce branch and statistical P.1411 median are alternative model families; do not sum them
composition_boundaries.p526: reflected path and P.526 diffraction are alternative mechanisms; do not add diffraction loss to the same isolated ray
composition_boundaries.research_sub_thz: do not add reflection gain/path to FSPL plus the historical 80 dB/event heuristic; compare side-by-side only
composition_boundaries.atmosphere: if later enabled, integrate specific attenuation separately over each leg; in a homogeneous medium this equals the same specific loss times d1+d2
composition_boundaries.canonical: no network, coverage, interference, radio-quality, optimizer, building-entry, or canonical propagation coupling

ankara_readiness_reference.interpretation: These are readiness/sample geometry counts, not viable reflected links. Visibility, material, roughness, terrain, antenna and coherent-field gates are not passed by these counts.

requirement_status.2_spreading: established; FSPL(total image path) selected for ideal planar mirror
requirement_status.3_p2040_gamma: established; one complex field coefficient, |Gamma|^2 once in power
requirement_status.5_te_tm_basis: specified from actual incidence plane; explicit TE/TM first scope
requirement_status.6_facade_geometry: required evidence defined; footprint edge alone is not physical wall proof
requirement_status.7_height: required evidence defined; fallback height rejected
requirement_status.8_roughness: qualified by Rayleigh criterion; unknown remains unknown
requirement_status.11_usefulness: single isolated reference is useful enough for a gated 4I.5B candidate
requirement_status.12_terrain: explicitly unavailable in current Ankara pack
requirement_status.14_fresnel: scale calculated; no arbitrary minimum asserted
requirement_status.17_coherence: direct-plus-reflected coherent sum excluded from first scope
requirement_status.18_material: explicit evidence required; no automatic OSM inference
requirement_status.19_measurement: campaign metadata and separation requirements defined
requirement_status.20_go_no_go: GO for reference-only candidate, NO for canonical/network multipath
requirement_status.24_source_authority: official ITU plus archival/peer-reviewed geometry evidence
requirement_status.26_hand_check: 140 GHz TE/TM example recorded in controlled derivation
requirement_status.29_validation: Go tests, race/vet, JSON/docs and diff checks required
requirement_status.30_limitations: explicit in audit document; no diffuse, curvature, multilayer uncertainty, or coherent network result claimed

promotion_policy.promotion_target: reference-only, opt-in, isolated single reflected path
required_before_4i5b: known interface/slab mode and thickness/coherence evidence
roughness/specularity evidence or a qualified unknown status
two-leg visibility and finite segment tests
